“朝哥，不用这么认真吧？”陈赤赤有些不爽的说道，他感觉自己已经很尽力了。

起身离座走到房间正中，两手轰然拍向地面的流芒召唤出了一座半人高的古怪机械，金架银底，旁边还带座冒烟的黑锅炉，红色的圆型绞盘嘎吱嘎吱像在磨砂。

除了谭棕铭以外，谁也不知道这场股市风暴，到底是在场哪一位大佬、又或者是说哪几位大佬发动的。

点，使用三次就消费点的数值，仅仅只有点的vip点数能让夏言进行召唤新的契约者，来让他尝试链接对自己有用的新世界。

咒腕作为暗杀教团的历代首领之一自然不是笨蛋，看似是发起自杀性冲锋，实则是他唯一能翻盘的机会。

“吾主在此！！！”白贞挥动战旗，往前一挡，全身散发出耀眼的光芒，一个球形结界衍生出来护住周身，毒炎压根侵不了半分。

看到两人搞笑的模样，邓朝李辰他们全笑疯了，你捂肚子我打滚，哈哈哈的玩命疯笑。

军姬柳眉微蹙，身影瞬间原地消失出现在高空，同时就是一梭子弹击中黑色弗格尔，但却只溅起一缕波澜，连漆都没蹭掉。

垲垲五体投地的趴在地下，要不是早早的铺了泡沫垫，光这一下就得把牙卡掉。

然而，却有少数的异类，会产生去掌控，跨越这一切的想法。从常识来讲，这就是所谓的好高骛远，不自量力的笨蛋，愚者。

这光网是隐神宗之前的一位大能在离去之前留下的上品灵器，它并不仅仅只是一个束缚的光网，更厉害的是被绑住的人在靠近光网时，光网会放出类似十万雷霆轰击般的电击。

景墨轩看向休息室的‘门’，目光深邃令人捉‘摸’不透。似乎是怀疑，似乎是担忧，又似乎是没有感情。

"Brother Chao, you don't have to be so serious, right?" Chen Chichi said somewhat unhappily. He felt that he had tried his best.

He stood up and left his seat and walked to the middle of the room. He slammed his hands on the ground and summoned a weird machine half a man tall. It had a gold frame and a silver base. There was a smoking black boiler next to it. The red round winch creaked like it was being frosted.

Except for Tan Zongming, no one knows which big boss present, or which big bosses, started this stock market storm.

Points are consumed after three uses. Only a few VIP points allow Xia Yan to summon new contractors so that he can try to connect to a new world that is useful to him.

As one of the past leaders of the Assassination Order, Cursed Wrist is naturally not an idiot. It seems like he is launching a suicidal charge, but in fact it is his only chance to make a comeback.

"My lord is here!!!" Bai Zhen waved the battle flag and stepped forward. His whole body emitted a dazzling light. A spherical barrier was formed to protect his whole body. The poisonous flames could not penetrate even half of it.

Seeing the funny looks of the two of them, Deng Chao, Li Chen and the others laughed like crazy. You covered your stomach and I rolled around, laughing like crazy.

Jun Ji frowned slightly, and her figure disappeared in an instant and appeared high in the sky. At the same time, a shuttle of bullets hit Black Fogel, but it only caused a ripple and did not even rub off the paint.

Nai was lying on the ground with all her body prostrated. If she hadn't laid out a foam mattress early, her teeth would have been stuck just this time.

However, there are a few outliers who have the idea of ​​​​controlling and transcending all this.From a common sense perspective, this is the so-called fool and fool who is too ambitious and overestimates his own capabilities.

This light net is a high-grade spiritual weapon left behind by a former great master of the Hidden God Sect before he left. It is not just a binding light net, but what is even more powerful is that when the bound person approaches the light net, the light net will emit an electric shock similar to the bombardment of a hundred thousand thunderbolts.

Jing Moxuan looked at the door of the lounge with a deep and unpredictable gaze.It seems to be doubtful, it seems to be worried, and it seems to be devoid of emotion.
